messages:
Maya: Heads up — Aster Labs (onboarding) just tripped the spend sensor: 3.1x expected token usage in the last 24h. Flagging for cost ops + QBR prep. :warning:
Jon: Yikes. Is this burst from embeddings or generation? Any specific routes?
Priya: Looks like heavy embedding churn. I see a spike on the /embed endpoint around 03:00 UTC.
Evan: I pulled the trace briefly — repeated retries from their client + long batch sizes. Could be a retry loop.
Maya: cs-notify-bot sent an alert earlier, pasted it below:
cs-notify-bot: ALERT: account=aster_labs, metric=token_usage, period=24h, delta=+210% vs baseline. URL: https://app.redwood/alerts/ast-987
Jon: Can someone run a quick billing snapshot for Aster? Need projected 30d burn with current pattern.
Priya: Running query now — snippet:
```
SELECT SUM(tokens) as tokens_24h FROM usage WHERE account_id='aster_labs' AND ts > now()-24h;
```
Will post numbers in ~5m.
Evan: Also adding a temporary quota guard on their route to prevent more runaway spend. Setting soft limit at current 95th pct.
Maya: thx. Also tagging enablement — @Priya can we book a 30m call to walk them through batching/kv-cache best practices before the renewal QBR? This looks like churn that can be fixed.
Priya: Yep — I can do tomorrow 10am PT. I'll include our embed-best-practices doc and a short checklist for SDK retry/backoff.
Jon: From a renewal risk POV, add this to the QBR risk tracker: "unexpected embed surge — potential prepaid consumption". Assigning to Maya to own mitigation for now.
Maya: Assigned. Action items: 1) billing snapshot + 30d burn estimate (Jon) 2) quota guard + alert tuning (Evan) 3) enablement call + checklist (Priya) 4) capture post-call notes + ops recommendations for QBR (Maya).
Priya: I'll capture customer concerns and any product asks in the post-call notes so we can feed that into the renewal playbook.
cs-notify-bot: NOTE: Guard applied to route /v1/embed for aster_labs, soft limit=1.5M tokens/day.
Evan: FYI I also created a temporary rollout to a cheaper quantized model for their non-critical embed jobs to reduce per-token spend.
Maya: Great. Once Jon posts the 30d forecast we'll decide whether to offer a short retainer credit or schedule a paid enablement.
Jon: 24h snapshot: 4.2M tokens, projection (if sustained) = ~126M tokens / 30d. Estimated monthly spend ~ $3.8k (current pricing tier). Sending csv to the ticket.
Priya: Thanks — I'll prep the call slide deck focused on batching, cache TTLs, and SDK retries.
Maya: Perfect. Capture any asks that might need product work (e.g., client-side batching helper) so we can grade as "quick win" vs long-term.
Evan: Noted. I'll keep guard in place and revisit after the enablement call.
Maya: Closing loop here — adding a short note to the renewal tracker and marking as "moderate risk; engage and remediate". Will update after the call. :white_check_mark:
